description: React component for rendering a line chart with dynamic data, resizing, and internationalized loading/empty states.

classes.name: LineChart
classes.description: React component class for displaying a line chart with configurable options and responsive behavior.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes the chart and sets up resize event listener.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates or destroys the chart based on data changes.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Cleans up chart and event listeners.

methods.name: resizeChart
methods.description: Resizes the chart canvas to 100% width if responsive.

methods.name: initChart
methods.description: Creates or updates the chart instance with current data and options.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the chart or loading/empty state messages.
